resources.string: Safe matches (package + signer) are selected by default. Signature mismatches cannot be accepted without a later manual override. Matching stays on-device.
No F-Droid index cached yet. Sync Sources first — safe (HIGH) matches need package + signer from a synced repo. Until then only GitHub-map suggestions appear under Review.
Privileged actions (silent install, later cache clean / debloat) need Shizuku or ShizukuPlus. Without it, Kiln stays on Tier NONE with system dialogs.
Install Shizuku (or ShizukuPlus). Prefer the official GitHub release for sideload builds.
Start Shizuku via Wireless debugging (Android 11+), the manager app, or ADB from a PC. Then return here.
Grant Kiln access in the Shizuku permission dialog. If you chose “Never ask again”, open the manager app and allow Kiln manually.
Shizuku is ready. Run the self-test to confirm shell UID and the capability matrix.
HyperOS/MIUI: enable “USB debugging (Security settings)” if wireless pairing fails; allow autostart and disable battery restrictions for Shizuku so the service survives sleep.
